description: This file defines a set of API functions for interacting with a Buzz/Share feature in an HRM system, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting posts and comments, as well as managing likes.

methods.name: fetchPostComments
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific post, with optional limit and detailed view.

methods.name: savePostComment
methods.description: Saves a new comment to a specific post.

methods.name: updatePostComment
methods.description: Updates an existing comment on a post.

methods.name: deletePostComment
methods.description: Deletes a comment from a post.

methods.name: fetchPostLikes
methods.description: Retrieves likes for a specific post.

methods.name: fetchPosts
methods.description: Fetches a list of posts with pagination and sorting options.

methods.name: updatePostLike
methods.description: Likes or unlikes a post based on the current state.

methods.name: updatePost
methods.description: Updates a post with new data, handling different types (photo, video, text).
